rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for tying or fastening something tightly.

example.english: I bind the box tightly with a rope.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 tiu4 sing4 bong2 sat6 go3 soeng1

rows.note: Use this specifically for bandaging or wrapping a wound or injured body part.

example.traditional: 我幫佢隻受傷嘅手包紮好。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bong1 keoi5 zek3 sau6 soeng1 ge3 sau2 baau1 zaat3 hou2

rows.note: Use this for binding books or putting pages together in a cover.

example.english: We need to take this book to the printer to bind it.
example.traditional: 我哋要攞呢本書去印刷廠裝訂。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 lo2 ni1 bun2 syu1 heoi3 jan3 caat3 cong2 zong1 ding3

rows.note: Use this specifically for flattening the chest by wearing a chest binder.

example.english: I bind my chest most days so my clothes fit better.
example.traditional: 我平時都會束胸，着衫好睇啲。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ping4 si4 dou1 wui5 cuk1 hung1 zoek3 saam1 hou2 tai2 di1
